Maria: Quick RFC follow-up — we need to pick a direction for continuous-batcher when KV-cache pinning is present. Two competing ideas: envelope-first vs affinity-first. TL;DR: tradeoffs around tail latency vs cache hit retention.
Alex: Can you outline the two options in one line each?
Maria: envelope-first = always respect tenant latency envelope (fast flush) even if it kills cache locality. affinity-first = prefer keeping KV cache warm by delaying flushes, may increase tail sometimes.
Joni: affinity-first preserves throughput and token-cost in steady-state, but we've seen headroom starvation for tenants with tight SLAs.
Sam: For interactive customers we can't exceed 150ms P95. Envelope-first nails P95 but costs more tokens.
Priya: Real-world question: how often do we see cache-warm windows > 2s that justify affinity? Need telemetry.
Maria: Good point. We have traces showing some long-lived sessions where a 1.5s delay saves ~30% token cost. But mixed workloads complicate it.
Alex: What about a hybrid: envelope for small request counts or tight SLA routes, affinity for long-lived streams?
Joni: Hybrid sounds promising. Implementation idea: per-route config with threshold: `batch.policy = "hybrid"` and `hybrid.affinity_window_ms = 1500` + `hybrid.envelope_p95_ms = 150`.
Sam: Concern: per-route config explodes surface area. We should have sane defaults and a feature flag for advanced tuning.
Priya: Also add a rollout metric set: cache_hit_ratio, p95_latency_by_route, token_per_request. If any route breaches SLA, flip to envelope-first automatically.
ops-bot: Alert: last canary of affinity-first saw 180ms P95 on /chat for tenant-42, triggered incident playbook.
deploy-bot: Note: canary was behind feature flag `batcher.hybrid_v1` — we can toggle.
Maria: Proposal: prototype hybrid behind feature flag with safe defaults (affinity_window_ms=1200, envelope_p95=150). Add automatic fallback to envelope-first when p95>SLA or error-rate spike. Rollout to internal tenants first. Who wants to own telemetry?
Priya: I'll own telemetry dashboards + rollback runbook. I'll add evals to Redwood Optimize to surface cost vs latency.
Alex: +1. Can we also add an experiment label so later analysis filters hybrid vs pure modes?
Maria: Yep. I'll open the RFC follow-up ticket with config sketch and rollout plan. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
